_why: The ads each shop is running RIGHT NOW. Rodney 2026-09-29: 'Kiki never understands when a customer asks for a certain advertisement... the guy asks for the price in size nine and Kiki starts sending them all type of pictures.' Facebook does not tell us which ad was tapped (and neither ManyChat nor YCloud passes it), so a customer arriving off an ad is invisible to us. This list is what they could possibly be asking about. Keep it in step with what is actually live - anything listed here is what Kiki will name and price. EACH ENTRY CARRIES ITS OWN `shop` (2026-10-07): Foot Fetish runs different ads from Trendy Kicks, and before this every line was told TK's ads and FF's were invisible - a customer tapped FF's six-Jordan $150 ad, said '11', and got the whole shelf. No `shop` = every line. The `price` here is the AD price and it is what Kiki quotes - that is how a shop runs a sale without cutting the price on the other two lines.
